'''Servogrips''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] hand used on a variety of models. [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] incorporated heavy servogrips into the [[PD-series protocol droid]] design to help deal with the terrain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lur]] when the company intended to market the droid to the [[Lurrian]]s. The servogrips could detach from the droid and be propelled by [[Engine/Legends|rocket jets]], trailing a thin strong cable. This allowed the PD-series to move through vertical environments.<ref name="EGTD" />

[[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] were equipped with precise servogrip pincers. They were capable of gentle movement when using medical tools such as [[laser scalpel]]s.<ref name="EGTD" />
